title: JM
titleNative: J⇔M ジェイエム
synopsis: J is a professional hitman... he was orphaned and raised by the yakuza as an assassin. He was too good, killed too many people, and knew too much about their organization. When the syndicate tried to erase him, their plan backfired...when three syndicates were wiped out completely, J became "untouchable." Megumi, a girl in third grade, was bullied by her classmates because she is half-Japanese, half-American, and gets good grades. One day, when they bumped their heads... they switched bodies. Now J is inside a cute girl's body...and Megumi is inside the tough guy's body. Now they must hide that they are not who they were and keep their everyday lives the same as before. J never knew how hard a girl's life is, and Megumi enjoys her new life?! (Source: BookWalker, edited)

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
titleNative: 大崎さんと小森さん
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

synopsis: "I'm going to enjoy my second single life!" Kazuha Ono is divorced at the age of 35 due to her husband's adultery. Refusing to feel down, she proudly tells her coworkers at a fashion magazine that she is now a free woman. A new coworker happened to be there to hear it, which made her feel a bit awkward. But then the that handsome new guy seems to take an interest in her after her announcement...?
